text: Gentle prolonged heat and slow cooling make the fat clot into a golden crust that is skimmed off. No culture, no acid.

steps.name: stand
steps.note: The milk is left in a shallow pan for hours, so its cream rises.
The cream is heated, floating on milk over steam or very hot water, or scalded alone at a lower temperature.
The cream is cooled slowly in the float method, or simply chilled in the scald method.
